subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.csv@rfc4180` is this plugin's own self-contained RFC 4180 CSV file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-has-header, insert-record, remove-record, set-field, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
